aboutPage.title: What is CREUP?
aboutPage.description: CREUP is the leading voice of students at public universities in Spain.
aboutPage.lead: The Coordinadora de Representantes de Estudiantes de Universidades Públicas (CREUP) brings together student councils and delegations from 37 public universities, representing more than 1,000,000 students.
aboutPage.intro: As a national reference body, CREUP channels students' needs and interests to public institutions and authorities, helping improve the university system.
aboutPage.activityParagraph1: To fulfill its mission, CREUP holds two General Assemblies each year where members agree on priorities, positions, and shared strategic lines.
aboutPage.activityParagraph2: It also promotes training events and spaces for exchanging experiences among student representatives, strengthening coordination and shared learning.
aboutPage.collaborationParagraph: CREUP maintains agreements and collaborative relationships with Higher Education organizations, such as CEDU, CRUE, and alumni associations, to reinforce the impact of student representation.
aboutPage.purposeParagraph: This work makes CREUP an essential actor for public universities: an organization that gives students a voice and works every day for a fairer, more participatory, and higher-quality Higher Education system.
aboutPage.missionText: Give students a voice to build and improve the university system.
aboutPage.visionText: Become the leading student representation body at the national level, serving as a bridge with associations and institutions.
aboutPage.sectionsDescription: If you want to go deeper into how we are organized and who is part of CREUP, visit these sections:

mic.title: Corporate Identity Manual
mic.description: Core elements of CREUP's visual identity: logos, corporate colors, and the full brand manual.
mic.introParagraph1: This Visual Identity Manual contains the core elements of the visual identity of the Coordinadora de Representantes de Estudiantes de Universidades Públicas, hereinafter CREUP.
mic.introParagraph2: These elements establish the construction guidelines, typography usage, and chromatic applications of the brand. Consolidating the brand image requires special attention to the recommendations set out in this manual, as a document that ensures consistency in public communication and outreach.
mic.introParagraph3: The manual should therefore be a dynamic tool, present in all corporate image applications. It remains, however, open to the creativity of the person using it.
mic.logosDescription: Below you can view and download all CREUP logo variants. The brand must always be reproduced following the corporate standards set out in this manual. Therefore,
mic.logosWarning: colors and proportions must never be altered.
mic.colorsDescription: In addition to white, these are the corporate colors and their codes.
mic.downloadDescription: Here you can download the full manual in PDF format.
